---
applyTo: "engagements/**/options.md"
---
# options.md schema
Exactly 2 or 3 options, `## O1 — <name>` … Each option has, in order:
- `**Summary**` (2–3 lines)
- `**Value**` two lines: `New capability:` what becomes possible that is not possible today (for the stakeholders' customers, users or decisions), or the words `none — efficiency only`; `Saved effort:` what gets cheaper or faster. Never present saved effort as a new capability.
- `**Fit to needs**` table: `| need | how addressed | strength(full/partial/none) |` — every H-priority need must appear
- `**Effort**` band: S / M / L / XL with one line of justification
- `**Risks**` (max 4 bullets)
- `**Assumptions that must be true**` (bullets)
- `**Not a fit if**` (one line)
End with `## Comparison` — one table, options as columns, rows: coverage of H needs, new capability (one phrase or `none`), effort, main risk, time to first value.
Do NOT recommend an option. The user chooses (gate G2).
